title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
title_zh: SpeedrunBench: 用电子游戏速通挑战 LLM 代理

paragraphs.en: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents’ capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SpeedrunBench , a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SpeedrunBench is a useful testbed for studying agents’ strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/patronus-ai/speedrun_bench
paragraphs.zh: 前沿 LLM 智能体已被证明能够解决人类拥有可衡量解决方案的、日益复杂的任务。 这引出了一个关键问题：LLM 智能体能否超越人类已经解决的问题？ 当人类开发的成熟解决方案不足以应对缺乏上下文或足够训练数据的问题时，制定复杂策略以解决重大影响问题的能力便显得至关重要。 我们通过视频游戏速通这一集体实践，研究智能体形成此类策略的能力。 在速通中，参与者会竞争在特定条件下完成一款视频游戏的最快方式，并在此过程中发现有趣的非传统玩法，这些玩法需要对底层游戏机制有深入的理解和掌握。 我们推出了 SpeedrunBench，一个用于评估前沿 LLM 智能体在 9 款不同游戏中的表现基准。 要在这个基准中取得良好表现，智能体必须反复改进策略、反思自身表现、利用已获得的知识，并在长期行动序列中进行推理，以解决一个日益困难的问题：比自己和他人更快。 我们的实验表明，尽管前沿智能体在简单的平台游戏中接近人类的世界纪录，但在实际资源限制下，它们在更长、更复杂的游戏中的表现仍落后于人类。 这些结果表明，SpeedrunBench 不仅是研究智能体策略形成能力的有效测试平台，也是一种抗饱和的评估方法，因为几乎总存在一个等待被发现的更快完成时间。 1 1 1 代码：https://github.com/patronus-ai/speedrun_bench

paragraphs.en: Through the rich history of AI research, games have served as a common testbed for developing ( Samuel, 1959 ; Tesauro, 1995 ) , testing ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ; Machado et al., 2018 ) and measuring ( Mnih et al., 2015 ; Badia et al., 2020 ) various techniques, from search ( Campbell et al., 2002 ; Silver et al., 2016 ) to state representation ( Mnih et al., 2015 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) , and reinforcement learning ( Silver et al., 2017 ; Vinyals et al., 2019 ; Berner et al., 2019 ) . Games serve multiple desiderata for AI researchers: they are cheap, reproducible simulations with a clear ground truth ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ; Kurach et al., 2020 ; Küttler et al., 2020 ) , have human baselines ( Mnih et al., 2015 ; Toromanoff et al., 2019 ) , require multiple different skills across various modalities ( Bellemare et al., 2013 ; Hafner, 2022 ; Reed et al., 2022 ) , and many games require long-horizon reasoning under partial observability ( Vinyals et al., 2017 ; Berner et al., 2019 ; Küttler et al., 2020 ) . In being such a fruitful playground for AI development, games have been a driver of progress in their own right: developing AI to outplay humans in complex games has produced techniques that found uses elsewhere in AI research ( Silver et al., 2018 ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; Mandhane et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在丰富的人工智能研究历史中，游戏一直作为开发（Samuel, 1959; Tesauro, 1995）、测试（Bellemare et al., 2013; Machado et al., 2018）和评估（Mnih et al., 2015; Badia et al., 2020）各种技术的通用试验平台，这些技术涵盖从搜索（Campbell et al., 2002; Silver et al., 2016）到状态表示（Mnih et al., 2015; Hafner et al., 2023），以及强化学习（Silver et al., 2017; Vinyals et al., 2019; Berner et al., 2019）等多个领域。 游戏满足了人工智能研究者的多项需求：它们是成本低廉且可重复的模拟环境，具有明确的基准答案（Bellemare et al., 2013; Kurach et al., 2020; Küttler et al., 2020）；提供了人类表现水平的参考基准（Mnih et al., 2015; Toromanoff et al., 2019）；需要跨多种模态运用多样化的技能（Bellemare et al., 2013; Hafner, 2022; Reed et al., 2022）；许多游戏还要求在部分可观测性条件下进行长期推理（Vinyals et al., 2017; Berner et al., 2019; Küttler et al., 2020）。 作为人工智能发展极具成效的试验场，游戏本身也推动了技术进步：开发能够超越人类水平的人工智能以应对复杂游戏，催生了许多在其他人工智能研究领域中得以应用的技术（Silver et al., 2018; Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Mandhane et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: It is no surprise, then, that games are once again an epicenter of AI evaluation. Their desirable qualities still hold as the landscape has shifted towards LLM agents, and prior work has leveraged many game genres ( Côté et al., 2018 ; Hausknecht et al., 2020 ; Paglieri et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Guertler et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and purpose-built game environments ( ARC Prize Foundation, 2026 ) in assessing model performance. However, benchmarking for game-playing agents has so far focused on completion : progress toward, or attainment of, the end of the game ( Paglieri et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . While this remains a difficult task and, at the time of writing, a challenging one for frontier models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; ARC Prize Foundation, 2026 ) , it does not provide researchers with an evergreen lens by which to continue to push and analyze model capabilities. No finite benchmark is immune to saturation, but some are more resistant, and we posit that speedrunning is a better fit for the current landscape of LLM agents evaluation. It is one thing for an agent to finish a complex game; it is another to be the fastest in the world to do so. Speedrunning is a community practice whereby players attempt to complete a game under specified criteria (e.g., with or without glitches) in the fastest possible time ( Scully-Blaker, 2014 ) . Players compete to beat the record, and discover strategies the game’s designers never anticipated (e.g., Figure 2 ). These strategies arise from the underlying dynamics of the game systems and speedrunners develop a more complete model of a game’s mechanics than the people that built it ( Scully-Blaker, 2018 ) . Game developers have responded in the past to speedrun records by patching their games, by deliberately preserving exploits, and by consulting speedrunners during development, with several studios reporting that speedrun analysis shaped design decisions ( Scully-Blaker, 2018 ; Francis, 2016 ) . Thus, speedrunning is a proven mechanism by which humans have developed a cooperative culture of strategy formulation to optimize a shared goal (finding the fastest possible route to the end) that had downstream consequences for other objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，游戏再次成为人工智能评估的核心领域也就不足为奇了。 尽管行业格局已向大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）转变，但游戏的理想特性依然成立；此前的研究已利用多种游戏类型（Côté et al., 2018; Hausknecht et al., 2020; Paglieri et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2024; Hu et al., 2026; Guertler et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025）以及专门构建的游戏环境（ARC Prize Foundation, 2026）来评估模型性能。 然而，迄今为止，游戏智能体的基准测试主要集中在通关上，即向游戏终点推进或达成终点（Paglieri et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2026）。 尽管这仍然是一项艰巨的任务，在撰写本文时甚至对前沿模型而言也充满挑战（Zhang et al., 2025; ARC Prize Foundation, 2026），但它并未为研究人员提供一个可持续的视角，以持续推动并分析模型的能力。 任何有限的基准测试都无法完全避免饱和问题，但有些测试更具抗饱和性；我们认为，竞速挑战（speedrunning）更适合当前大型语言模型智能体评估的格局。 一个智能体能通关复杂游戏是一回事，而成为世界上通关速度最快的智能体则是另一回事。 竞速挑战是一种社区实践：玩家试图在特定规则下（例如是否允许使用漏洞）以尽可能短的时间完成一款游戏（Scully-Blaker, 2014）。 玩家们相互竞争以打破纪录，并发现游戏设计师从未预料到的策略（例如，图2）。 这些策略源于游戏系统的底层动态机制，而竞速挑战者对游戏机制的理解比开发者本身更为完整（Scully-Blaker, 2018）。 过去，游戏开发者曾针对竞速挑战的纪录做出回应：通过发布补丁、刻意保留漏洞，或在开发过程中与竞速挑战者沟通；多家工作室报告称，竞速分析影响了他们的设计决策（Scully-Blaker, 2018; Francis, 2016）。 因此，竞速挑战已被证明是一种有效机制：人类通过它发展出一种协作性的策略制定文化，以优化共同目标（找到通往终点的最快路线），而这一过程也对其他目标产生了连锁影响。

paragraphs.en: As prior work has noted ( Vinyals et al., 2019 ; Berner et al., 2019 ) , games require long-horizon reasoning. Speedrunning stresses this further, as one must reason beyond what constitutes an acceptable solution to finding the fastest one. The state and action space of a game, even if held to be deterministic under a fixed seed, is finite but exponential in the machine’s memory ( Hearn & Demaine, 2009 ) , and it grows with every frame a run requires. If we take Super Mario Bros. for instance it has been shown to be NP-hard ( Aloupis et al., 2015 ) to complete, and speedrunning requires an additional optimality constraint, which makes it a more complex problem ( Krentel, 1988 ) . Proving optimality in this context practically requires either a structural lower bound (e.g., the run must contain at least n n unavoidable frames) or exhaustion of the reachable space. This the source of speedrunning’s resistance to saturation, a game can be observed to be unsaturated whenever a new run exceeds the known best time, but saturation itself cannot be proven without solving the optimization problem outright. Thus, in practical terms, we should expect LLM agents to find speedrunning substantially harder than completion, as the task does not saturate when the agent does a successful valid run, every new record is an upper bound upon which to improve, and this improvement requires counterfactual reasoning about alternative routes and mechanics that no single episode reveals. In the same way that beating the world’s experts at Go and Chess led to ground-breaking research in reinforcement learning ( Silver et al., 2016 ; Silver et al., 2018 ) , we believe speedrunning can invoke similar innovation in LLM agents.

paragraphs.en: In this paper we introduce SpeedrunBench , a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on speedrunning games, covering 10+ frontier agents and 9 different games. We evaluate agents in three settings: an online computer-use setting and two new offline settings. In online , an agent observes the current frame and selects the next action or short sequence of actions while the game runs. In both offline settings, the agent repeatedly edits and replays a complete frame-indexed action trace for a fixed number of iterations. offline-seed begins with a goal-reaching reference trajectory and focuses on improving it, whereas offline-scratch requires the agent to first construct a successful trajectory. Each setting highlights a different capability: online requires multimodal real-time perception, offline-scratch requires route discovery, as the agent begins without a successful trajectory, and offline-seed focuses on improving an existing solution, as the agent begins with a successful reference trajectory. All settings demand long-horizon coherence, since the agent has to keep improving a route it already holds, over many turns, without breaking it. Our experiments (Figure 1 ) show that while recent frontier agents approach human world records on simpler platformer games, they remain slower on long, complex games such as role-playing, racing, and strategy games, given a fixed budget. Even when given a successful trace as a starting point, agents achieve only marginal improvements, showing a gap between finding a valid solution and improving it.

paragraphs.en: Games have been serving as evaluation benchmarks for machine learning (ML) models well before LLMs became popular, from text adventures ( Côté et al., 2018 ) to 2D navigation ( Guruprasad et al., 2026 ) and abstract reasoning tasks ( ARC Prize Foundation, 2026 ) . Games were also the setting for some of the field’s most visible results before LLMs, from Atari from pixels ( Mnih et al., 2015 ) to superhuman play in Go ( Silver et al., 2016 ) and StarCraft II ( Vinyals et al., 2019 ) . Recent benchmarks extend the setting to let frontier LLMs play games directly. LMGame-Bench ( Hu et al., 2026 ) supplies perception and memory scaffolds, standardizes prompting, and screens for training data contamination, while VideoGameBench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) asks whether vision-language models (VLMs) can complete popular titles at all. Taesiri et al. (2024) pairs images with questions to evaluate whether a VLM can identify what is wrong in a rendered screen. Individual titles have also served as milestones in their own right, with Gemini 2.5 Pro clearing Pokémon 2 2 2 Pokémon is a trademark of Nintendo Co., Ltd., Creatures Inc., and Game Freak Inc. in 406.5 hours over two attempts ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , and Hu et al. (2024) testing LLM capability on Pokémon battles specifically. Minecraft is the main setting where the objective is not merely completing something: MineDojo ( Fan et al., 2022 ) and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) score an agent on how much it acquires in an open world, by items obtained and skills learned. In contrast, SpeedrunBench scores how quickly it was completed, which continues to separate models after completion is reached by challenging them to learn and discover speedrun-related skills.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）流行之前很久，游戏就已经被用作机器学习（ML）模型的评估基准，从文字冒险游戏（Côté et al., 2018）到二维导航任务（Guruprasad et al., 2026），再到抽象推理任务（ARC Prize Foundation, 2026）。 在LLM出现之前，游戏也是该领域一些最引人注目的成果的发生地，从基于像素的Atari游戏（Mnih et al., 2015）到围棋和《星际争霸II》中超越人类水平的表现（Silver et al., 2016；Vinyals et al., 2019）。 近期的基准测试将这一场景扩展到了让前沿LLM直接参与游戏。 LMGame-Bench（Hu et al., 2026）提供了感知和记忆框架，统一了提示规范，并筛查了训练数据污染问题；而VideoGameBench（Zhang et al., 2025）则旨在检验视觉语言模型（VLM）是否 вообще能够完成热门游戏。Taesiri等人 （2024）将图像与问题相结合，以评估VLM能否识别渲染屏幕中的错误之处。 个别游戏本身也成为了重要的里程碑：Gemini 2.5 Pro在两次尝试中耗时406.5小时通关了《宝可梦2 2 2》（注：宝可梦是任天堂公司、Creatures Inc.和Game Freak Inc.的商标）（Comanici et al., 2025），而Hu等人 （2024）则专门测试了LLM在宝可梦对战中的能力。 《我的世界》是一个主要场景，其目标不仅仅是完成某项任务：MineDojo（Fan et al., 2022）和Voyager（Wang et al., 2024）通过智能体在开放世界中获得的物品和掌握的技能来评估其学习程度。 相比之下，SpeedrunBench则根据完成任务的速度进行评分；即使模型已经通关，它仍通过要求智能体学习和发现速通相关的技能来继续区分不同模型的表现。

paragraphs.en: Exploration : The agent needs to “think outside the box” to explore new paths and approaches to minimize the frames to the goal. This capability is tested especially in an offline-scratch setup where given seed gameplay trajectories are not necessarily fast gameplays.

paragraphs.en: We define a game as a deterministic environment with state space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and a finite action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , the set of controller inputs available on that console. Play begins from a fixed initial state s 0 ∈ 𝒮 s_{0}\in\mathcal{S} , and each action advances the game by one frame, so a sequence of actions in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} fully determines a run. We explore three settings per game: Online , Offline-Scratch , Offline-Seed for measuring different capabilities of each model (Figure 3 ). We further explain these three different setups in the following paragraphs.

The agent repeats this for a fixed number of turns (200 unless specified). paragraphs.en: For offline setup, we use a self-improving loop inspired by auto-research ( Karpathy, 2026 ) to mimic humans speedrunning by playing the game multiple times, see where time was lost, change one thing, and run it again, for as long as the route keeps giving. The offline settings reproduce that structure. At each iteration the agent selects its current best trace and the record of what it has already tried, proposes an edit, and receives a verdict. We fix both the number of iterations and how many candidate traces the agent may evaluate within one iteration before committing to the edit it submits. These hyperparameters are left fixed across models. (§ 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于离线设置，我们采用一种受自动研究（Karpathy, 2026）启发的自我改进循环，通过多次玩游戏来模仿人类的速通行为：观察时间浪费在何处，改变一个因素，然后再次运行，只要该路线仍有提升空间。 离线设置复现了这一结构。 在每次迭代中，智能体选择当前最佳路径及其已尝试操作的记录，提出一次修改，并收到评估结果。 我们固定了迭代次数以及智能体在一次迭代内可评估的候选路径数量，之后才会提交最终的修改方案。 这些超参数在所有模型中均保持固定。（§ 5.1）

paragraphs.en: Super Mario Brothers, Super Mario Land, and SuperTux ( The SuperTux Team, 2021 ) are 2D side-scrolling platformers, which demand precise movement and route discovery toward a level exit. The goal is finishing Level 1-1. Both Mario titles have decades of documented routes and world records, which supplies an external speedrun reference, and they are also the titles which are most likely to have been exposed to LLMs during pretraining. SuperTux is the open-source counterpart that makes the extent of exposure measurable: it has similar gameplay as Mario for the agent while carrying none of the same pretraining exposure. We use its “Welcome to Antarctica” level, referred to as SuperTux 1-1 throughout.

paragraphs.en: In the experiments so far, the agent holds no in-turn scorer: it submits one trace per turn and gets one verdict. Here, we instead let the agent evaluate its own candidates, up to 200 per turn, and hold all else fixed. On SuperTux 1-1 this gives a controlled comparison, since the same models start from the same 9,498-frame seed and run for the same 200 turns in both settings (Table 3 ). With the scorer, every model escapes the seed and ends 4.0–5.1 × \times below where it ended without it. DeepSeek-V4-Pro reaches 1,847 frames, within 7% of the world record and about two seconds slower, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM 5.2 remain 16% and 29% above it (Figure 6(a) ). On Super Mario Land 1-1, GLM 5.2 with the scorer comes within 3% of the record after 220K evaluated traces over ∼ \sim 114 hours (Figure 6(b) ), against 5,643 frames from the same human seed without it. For these models, access to a scorer decides whether an agent escapes a non-optimal seeded trace, and given enough evaluations the strongest agent on each short 2D level comes close to its world record.

paragraphs.en: That famous titles are memorized in model parameters is well known: Hu et al. (2026) reports game content memorised during pretraining, and Gemini 2.5 Pro has been observed confusing items across Pokémon versions, expecting tea where the game requires soda ( Zhang, 2025 ) . Hence, we add a controlled pair: Pokémon and Tuxemon holding genre and setting fixed while varying how much a title is likely to appear in a pretraining corpus. Both are turn-based RPGs, run under offline-seed with the same iteration budget and scored on frames to the first gym. Figure 7 shows that lower popularity does not make the open-source title harder to improve on when compared to the Pokémon run is the one in Figure 4(b) . No model improves on the Pokémon seed by more than 1%, whereas GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.6 improve on the Tuxemon seed by 6.9% and 5.9%. Tuxemon is harder to make any progress on since every model on Pokémon submits at least one trace faster than the seed, while four of ten never submit a trace that reaches the Tuxemon gym. Across ten models run on both titles, the rank correlation observed b/w titles is slightly negative at − 0.18 -0.18 . Hence, we see that results on a popular title are not predictive of performance on an unfamiliar one, which is consistent with popular titles being present in pretraining corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 众所周知，那些著名作品的名称会被记忆在模型参数中：Hu 等人（2026）报告了预训练期间被记忆的游戏内容，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 也被观察到会混淆不同版本《宝可梦》中的物品，在游戏要求使用汽水时却期望使用茶（Zhang, 2025）。因此，我们添加了一组受控对比：《宝可梦》和《Tuxemon》在类型和设定上保持一致，但作品在预训练语料库中出现的概率则有所不同。两者都是回合制角色扮演游戏，均在离线种子模式下运行，迭代预算相同，并以到达第一个道场的帧数为评分标准。图 7 显示，与图 4(b) 中的《宝可梦》运行结果相比，较低的人气并不会使开源作品的改进变得更困难。没有任何模型能将《宝可梦》种子的表现提升超过 1%，而 GLM 5.3 和 Grok 4.6 则将《Tuxemon》种子的表现分别提升了 6.9% 和 5.9%。《Tuxemon》更难取得任何进展，因为所有在《宝可梦》上的模型都至少比种子版本快一个轨迹，而十款模型中有四款从未提交过能到达《Tuxemon》道场的轨迹。在十款同时运行于两款作品的模型中，观测到的作品间等级相关性为轻微的负值（−0.18）。因此，我们看到，在热门作品上的结果并不能预测其在陌生作品上的表现，这与热门作品存在于预训练语料库中的情况是一致的。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SpeedrunBench , a benchmark that measures agents’ capability by assessing how fast an agent can finish a game and comparing it with the best known completion time. SpeedrunBench evaluates agents across three settings: an online setting where agents get frame by frame screen shots and must take an action, and two offline settings where agents must optimize their game plan for the run either with a seeded trace or without. We show that our benchmark remains challenging for current models (RQ1), as no agent reaches human world record on any game under a practical budget, with the best performing agent being on average more than twice as slow as the world record set by human players. Additionally we show that agents can improve their gameplay in an autoresearch-like loop (RQ2), even when the start seed is a near-optimal tool-assisted speedrun trace. However, giving the agents a slow seed as a starting point holds them back. Agents perform better when they can construct the routes of their own accord, and expanding the agents’ ability to evaluate a candidate with a larger per-turn budget, as seen with how close the platformer games came to the world records. We hope that SpeedrunBench inspires others to consider speedrunning as an avenue for pushing model abilities such as strategic thinking and long horizon coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpeedrunBench，这是一个通过评估智能体完成游戏的速度并将其与已知最佳完成时间进行比较，来衡量智能体能力的基准测试。 SpeedrunBench 在三种设置下对智能体进行评估：在线设置中，智能体逐帧获取屏幕截图并必须采取行动；两种离线设置中，智能体必须根据是否提供初始种子轨迹来优化其游戏运行计划。 我们的研究结果表明，该基准测试对当前模型而言仍然具有挑战性（RQ1），因为在实际预算限制下，没有任何智能体能在任何游戏中达到人类世界纪录水平，表现最佳的智能体平均速度也比人类玩家创造的世界纪录慢两倍多。 此外，我们还发现，即使初始种子是近乎最优的工具辅助速通轨迹，智能体仍能在类似自动研究的循环中提升其游戏表现（RQ2）。 然而，如果为智能体提供较慢的初始种子作为起点，则会限制其发挥。 当智能体能够自主规划路线时，其表现会更好；同时扩大智能体在每次行动中评估候选方案的能力预算，也能显著提升效果，正如平台游戏的表现已接近世界纪录一样。 我们希望 SpeedrunBench 能激励更多人将速通视为推动模型能力（如战略思维和长期连贯性）发展的有效途径。
